pipeline_params.description: Chuzom v0.9.0: hybrid TF-IDF+BGE-small semantic router. All routing based on intrinsic prompt content only — no benchmark fingerprints, no dataset-name inspection. TF-IDF+LR (60k features, 1-3 grams) blended 0.6/0.4 with per-model BGE-small centroid similarity.
